patterns.name: Directional fall blend is caller-owned state with shared part traversal
patterns.claim: Fall, FallAerial and FallSpecial pass their own x4 address to the shared selector. patterns.name: ftFx_SpecialS_GetGhostRotationIndexed

patterns.name: Callback installation and retention require separate evidence
patterns.claim: Fox dash setup installs accessory4_cb after the motion change; its graphics callback clears that slot. Fighter transition callback-assignment code also clears accessory slots. These mechanisms do not imply one universal one-shot or ownership-transfer contract.
